assisted-full-planche-hold.label: Extend together to marked wall contact, hold six seconds, tuck and land
assisted-full-planche-hold.camera: Full-body side-oblique view; fixed bars, locked knees/elbows and equal-height toe contacts stay visible. Contact markers fade only while feet are stationary at the wall, without any upward tether or quantified unloading.

full-planche-hold.label: Extend both straight legs together, hold five seconds, tuck and land
full-planche-hold.camera: Full-body side-oblique view with both straight legs together and feet clear. Body and limb lengths remain consistent through entry, extension and return; no wall or assistance graphic.

bent-arm-tuck-press-to-handstand.label: Grounded tuck, bend then press to lockout, settle two seconds, exit separately
phases: Press to locked arms in tuck
bent-arm-tuck-press-to-handstand.camera: Side-oblique full-body view shows grounded feet, visible elbow bend, compact unsupported tuck, unloaded head, locked-arm top and separate split exit. Segment lengths remain coherent; no wall catch.

straddle-press-to-handstand.label: Grounded straight-knee straddle, hips rise, close at the top, settle two seconds
straddle-press-to-handstand.camera: Full-body oblique view keeps both straight straddled legs and locked elbows visible; hips stack before the legs close. Grounded setup, unassisted top and separate landing stay in frame.

pike-press-to-handstand.label: Grounded together-leg pike, lift hips through locked arms, settle two seconds
pike-press-to-handstand.camera: Full-body side view shows straight together legs and locked elbows through the ascent, followed by a separately scored top and safe exit. No wall catch, jump or L-sit start.
